steps: 100 steps of 64 questions x 8 sampled answers (51,200 rollouts)
notes:
## Notes

- By question type (base to adapter): `run_rate` 91.75% to 99.00%, `chase_rate` 68.12% to 94.62%, `milestone` 99.62% to 99.50%. The base model had 9.42% of its answers cut off at the 4,096-token limit; with the adapter none were.
- The adapter makes the model answer with very little written reasoning (about 107 tokens on average). That is what the reward asked for; expect the same terse style on other questions.
- Checked on 2026-11-24: Option 1 and Option 2 with transformers 5.22.2 and peft 0.21.2 (the adapter and the merged model give the same answers on sample questions), Option 3 with vLLM 0.31 (used for the results above).
- `adapter_model.safetensors` holds 198 tensors. 12 of them belong to two `mtp` layers that exist in the NeMo Automodel version of the model but not in the transformers version; PEFT skips those 12 and loads the other 186.
- Single training run, single seed. Differences of a point or less are not significant.
